unverified_source_notes.reason: canonical motion analysis lacks typed provenance linked to verified raw evidence

source_value.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: the clip is an official screen recording narrated by a presenter who stays in a round webcam bubble at the lower right. Inside it, a pointer hovers the sidebar's Add task control until an "Add task" tooltip appears at ~30s and clicks it, and text then types itself into the task field one character at a time — "send quote by eod today" over 42.0-45.4s and "call mom every other day at 9am" over 49.7-52.8s.
source_value.start_state: Full-frame webcam shot of the presenter talking, with no product surface visible (0-11.5s).
source_value.end_state: The Todoist macOS Inbox for the account "Denise" holding four tasks — Record videos (Today 5 PM), Focus time! (Yesterday 9-11 AM in red), send quote by eod (Today), call mom (Sunday 9 AM with a recurrence glyph) — held unchanged to the last frame (84-90.0s).
source_value.continuity: One 90.033s render of 2698 frames (~29.97 fps). Motion inside a scene is continuous — characters appear one at a time in the task field, the date chip fills itself in while the words are still being typed ("Today" by 44s, "Sunday 9 AM" by 52s), the "Task added to Inbox" toast slides up at 46.0s and is still on screen at 60.6s — and scenes are joined by hard cuts: webcam to the cream agenda card at ~11.8s, agenda card back to webcam at ~16.8s, Inbox to the mint Clarify card at ~75.1s and back to the Inbox at ~77.3s. No still-image interpolation.
source_value.feedback: Every action draws a visible answer in the same frame: the hovered sidebar control raises an "Add task" tooltip at ~30s; typed prose is parsed into a chip while typing continues, so "...by eod today" produces a green "Today ×" chip at 44-45s and "...every other day at 9am" produces a "Sunday 9 AM ×" chip at ~52s; activating the red Add task button both inserts the new row into the Inbox list and raises a "Task added to Inbox" toast carrying an Open link, at 46.0s and again at 54.2s.
